text: Third Nurse Attacked at Hopital Lamarck

text: Morphine Stolen From 3 Staff
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · the gazette's subheadline

text:
3 members of staff at Hopital Lamarck were attacked this week. Each was alone in a room at the back of the building. None of them saw the attacker.

Each one had just taken morphine from the hospital's Drug Reserve. The attacker took it. Every staff door in the building reads a badge.

text: THE 3 STATEMENTS
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `statements` — title

text:
**Amira Saleh, Monday `2026-02-02`.** Around 15:30 I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then I went into the `Supply Room` alone. A few minutes later I heard the badge reader, and the door opened behind me. A hand over my mouth. "The box," he said, and took it. I never saw his face, and I did not recognise his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.

**Helen Shaw, Wednesday `2026-02-04`.** Around 11:10 I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then I took a bag to the `Waste Room`. I heard the badge reader, and somebody came in after me. He pushed me into the wall and took the box. He took only the box. My bag and my telephone stayed on the floor. I never saw his face, and I did not recognise his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.

**Grace Mensah, Thursday `2026-02-05`.** Just before 16:00, I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then the `Loading Bay`. The shutter to the street was down: it is closed from 10:00 in the morning. The badge reader, the door, then his arm. He took the box. I never saw his face or recognised his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.

text: HOW TO SEND AN ANSWER
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `how-to-answer` — title

text:
Once you have the name, return that person's row from `staff_badges`.

For example, if you think the answer is Amira Saleh, type this:

```sql
SELECT *
FROM staff_badges
WHERE holder = 'Amira Saleh'
```

text: ON THE DRUG RESERVE DOOR
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `reserve-memo` — title

text:
Badge and code.

The code is given to the 7 staff whose `role` is `Nurse`. The `Pharmacist` has his own key. He fills the `Drug Reserve` in the evening. Nobody else gets in.

text: ARREST REPORT, 6 FEBRUARY
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `the-arrest` — title

text:
**16:48, `Linen Room`.** Owen Clarke goes in. 2 officers are already inside.

**16:50.** Colin Marsh badges in behind him and shuts the door. Arrested. No resistance.

**In his coat:** the box of morphine taken from Grace Mensah on Thursday.
